lines.text: What if the Sun vanished? How soon would you know?
lines.phonemes: wˌʌt ɪf ðə sˈʌn vˈænɪʃt? hˌaʊ sˈuːn wʊd juː nˈoʊ?

lines.text: Rewind. Earth circles the Sun about a hundred and fifty million kilometers out, at nearly thirty kilometers a second. Sunlight crosses that gap in eight minutes and twenty seconds.
lines.phonemes: ɹᵻwˈaɪnd. ˈɜːθ sˈɜːkəlz ðə sˈʌn ɐbˌaʊt ɐ hˈʌndɹɪd ænd fˈɪfti mˈɪliən kˈɪləmˌiːɾɚz ˈaʊt, æt nˌɪɹli θˈɜːɾi kˈɪləmˌiːɾɚz ɐ sˈɛkənd. sˈʌnlaɪt kɹˈɔsᵻz ðæt ɡˈæp ɪn ˈeɪt mˈɪnɪts ænd twˈɛnti sˈɛkəndz.

lines.text: Now switch the Sun off. Its last light is still on the way, so for over eight minutes, your sky looks exactly the same.
lines.phonemes: nˈaʊ swˈɪtʃ ðə sˈʌn ˈɔf. ɪts lˈæst lˈaɪt ɪz stˈɪl ɔnðə wˈeɪ, sˌoʊ fɔːɹ ˌoʊvɚɹ ˈeɪt mˈɪnɪts, jʊɹ skˈaɪ lˈʊks ɛɡzˈæktli ðə sˈeɪm.

lines.text: Gravity is no faster: changes in it travel at the speed of light. In twenty seventeen, gravitational waves and light from colliding neutron stars crossed a hundred and thirty million light-years, and arrived less than two seconds apart.
lines.phonemes: ɡɹˈævᵻɾi ɪz nˈoʊ fˈæstɚ: tʃˈeɪndʒᵻz ɪn ɪt tɹˈævəl æt ðə spˈiːd ʌv lˈaɪt. ɪn twˈɛnti sˈɛvəntˌiːn, ɡɹˌævɪtˈeɪʃənəl wˈeɪvz ænd lˈaɪt fɹʌm kəlˈaɪdɪŋ nˈuːtɹɑːn stˈɑːɹz kɹˈɔst ɐ hˈʌndɹɪd ænd θˈɜːɾi mˈɪliən lˈaɪtjˈɪɹz, ænd ɚɹˈaɪvd lˈɛs ðɐn tˈuː sˈɛkəndz ɐpˈɑːɹt.

lines.text: So for eight minutes, Earth keeps circling a Sun that isn't there. Then the news arrives, and Earth sails off in a straight line.
lines.phonemes: sˌoʊ fɔːɹ ˈeɪt mˈɪnɪts, ˈɜːθ kˈiːps sˈɜːklɪŋ ɐ sˈʌn ðæt ˌɪzənt ðˈɛɹ. ðˈɛn ðə nˈuːz ɚɹˈaɪvz, ænd ˈɜːθ sˈeɪlz ˈɔf ɪn ɐ stɹˈeɪt lˈaɪn.

lines.text: Light and gravity share one speed limit. Everything you see in the sky is old news.
lines.phonemes: lˈaɪt ænd ɡɹˈævᵻɾi ʃˈɛɹ wˈʌn spˈiːd lˈɪmɪt. ˈɛvɹɪθˌɪŋ juː sˈiː ɪnðə skˈaɪ ɪz ˈoʊld nˈuːz.

lines.text: Light time, Sun to Earth: eight minutes, twenty seconds. From the center of our galaxy: twenty-seven thousand years.
lines.phonemes: lˈaɪt tˈaɪm, sˈʌn tʊ ˈɜːθ: ˈeɪt mˈɪnɪts, twˈɛnti sˈɛkəndz. fɹʌmðə sˈɛntɚɹ ʌv ˌaʊɚ ɡˈælɐksi: twˈɛntisˈɛvən θˈaʊzənd jˈɪɹz.

lines.text: Next: how long would it take us to reach the nearest star?
lines.phonemes: nˈɛkst: hˌaʊ lˈɔŋ wʊd ɪt tˈeɪk ˈʌs tə ɹˈiːtʃ ðə nˌɪɹɪst stˈɑːɹ?
